# Sonatype

> > Sonatype secures the software supply chain with AI-driven open source security, artifact management, and vulnerability intelligence.

Sonatype provides comprehensive software supply chain security solutions including the Nexus One Platform, artifact repositories, SCA tools, and malware protection. The company stewards Maven Central Repository and serves as a trusted partner for developers, DevOps teams, and AppSec professionals managing open source dependencies and AI model security.

## Key Topics

- Software Supply Chain Security
- Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
- Open Source Security
- Artifact Repository Management
- Vulnerability Management
- Malware Protection
- SBOM Management
- DevSecOps
- Dependency Management
- AI Governance
- Nexus Repository
- Sonatype Lifecycle
- Repository Firewall
- CI/CD Integration
- Software Compliance

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Sonatype Nexus One Platform](https://www.sonatype.com/products/nexus-one-platform): AI-driven software supply chain management and open source security platform
- [Sonatype Nexus Repository](https://www.sonatype.com/products/sonatype-nexus-repository): Industry-leading artifact repository for software artifacts and AI models
- [Sonatype Lifecycle](https://www.sonatype.com/products/open-source-security-dependency-management): SCA tools for open source security and automated vulnerability management
- [Sonatype Repository Firewall](https://www.sonatype.com/products/sonatype-repository-firewall): AI-powered malware and malicious code protection for supply chains
- [Sonatype SBOM Manager](https://www.sonatype.com/products/sonatype-sbom-manager): Automate software compliance with audit-ready SBOM generation and tracking
- [Sonatype Intelligence Engine](https://www.sonatype.com/products/intelligence): Leading vulnerability intelligence for open source security and risk assessment
- [Sonatype Guide](https://www.sonatype.com/products/sonatype-guide): AI-assisted dependency management for coding assistants and developers

## Maven Central & Repository

- [Maven Central Repository](https://www.sonatype.com/products/maven-central-repository): Largest Java repository stewarded by Sonatype for 20+ years

## Solutions by Role

- [Software Developers](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/software-developers): Developer tools including Sonatype Guide for productivity and open source security
- [DevOps Teams](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/devops): DevSecOps solutions for secure pipelines, vulnerability management, and compliance
- [AppSec Professionals](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/appsec-professionals): Application security solutions with Lifecycle, Repository Firewall, and SBOM Manager
- [Open Source AI Security](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/open-source-ai): SCA and governance for AI models and dependencies
- [Software Composition Analysis Tools](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/software-composition-analysis-tools): SCA tools for vulnerability identification, compliance management, and open source risk
- [Open Source Malware Protection](https://www.sonatype.com/solutions/open-source-malware-protection): Malware protection solution with proactive detection and Repository Firewall blocking

## Integration & Deployment

- [Integrations](https://www.sonatype.com/products/integrations): Sonatype integrations with CI/CD, IDE, and DevOps tools for seamless security
- [Deployments](https://www.sonatype.com/products/deployments): Deployment options: cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped environments with Nexus Repository
